To create a complete and accurate set of release notes, I need the following details about the upcoming release:

| Item | Description |
|------|-------------|
| **Version** | Full version string (e.g., `v2.3.0`). |
| **Breaking changes** | A list of the breaking changes introduced in this release (description, impact, and any migration steps). |
| **New features** *(if any)* | Details of new functionality, APIs, UI components, etc. |
| **Bug fixes** *(if any)* | Descriptions of bugs that were resolved, including issue identifiers or ticket numbers. |
| **Other changes** *(optional)* | Any additional updates such as performance improvements, deprecations, documentation updates, etc. |
